queries:
WITH media_type_stats AS (
    SELECT
        MediaTypeId,
        AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track
    WHERE Bytes > 10323804
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
    AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count
FROM media_type_stats

SELECT
    AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond),
    AVG(track_count)
FROM (
    SELECT
        MediaTypeId,
        AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track
    WHERE Bytes >= 10323804
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)

SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond), AVG(track_count)
FROM (
    SELECT
        MediaTypeId,
        1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track
    WHERE Bytes > 10323804
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)

SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond), AVG(track_count)
FROM (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes >= 10323804
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)

SELECT
    mt.Name AS MediaType,
    AVG(CASE WHEN t.Bytes > 10323804
             THEN CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds
        END) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond,
    COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
FROM MediaType AS mt
JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes > 10323804 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes >= 10323804
             THEN CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds
             ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
FROM Track
GROUP BY MediaTypeId
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes >= 10323804 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
